question: Does each natural Plate's pooled stereo ERB-time response remain more consistent across p25/p50/p75 than between different Plates at the same position label?

decision.rationale: Within-Plate full ERB-time similarity is lower at the median than the same-position between-Plate control (0.480 vs 0.529), with only 47.2% within-over-between pairwise dominance and 0/36 same-Plate nearest neighbors. Time-integrated and late-tail profiles reverse direction (0.828 vs 0.722; 0.805 vs 0.713), while per-Plate grouping varies. This supports partial band-profile retention, not consistent full time-frequency identity across contact position.

implementationFacts: Reanalyzed only the 36 existing native fixed-gain isolated PCM outputs: 12 frozen Plates at p25/p50/p75.
Each source PCM path, byte count and SHA-256 matched the existing render manifest before analysis.
Within each Plate, geometry topology, material and node count match across contact positions.

representation.binBoundaryRule: half-open [low, high); frequency-bin centers mapped to equal ERB-rate bands; DC included in first band
representation.dcTreatment: DC one-sided linear power is undoubled; positive-frequency bins are doubled
representation.stereoPooling: mean left/right linear ERB-band power per frame before all profile and shape calculations

native.linearPower: |rFFT|^2/sum(Hann)^2; double positive-frequency bins except DC; sum linear bin power before dB

shapeOnlyDiagnostic.normalization: divide pooled nonnegative linear ERB-time power by its total across 279 frames x 30 bands; unit-sum per response
shapeOnlyDiagnostic.primaryMetric: cosine similarity on flattened unit-sum full ERB-time distributions; bounded [0,1]
shapeOnlyDiagnostic.floor: none; no dB conversion or floor before normalization/similarity
shapeOnlyDiagnostic.note: Cosine is scale invariant; unit-sum normalization makes the shape-only intent explicit and remains separate from native level metrics.

representation.integratedProfile: sum pooled linear ERB power across all 279 frames; unit-sum each 30-band profile; cosine similarity
representation.lateTailProfile: sum pooled linear ERB power at left-aligned frame start >= 0.5 s (185 frames, 501.333... ms through 1.482666... s); unit-sum each 30-band profile; cosine similarity

pairDefinitions.between: 198 different-Plate pairs within the same p25, p50 or p75 label

floorDiagnostics.metricUse: Full/integrated/late shape similarities use unfloored linear power; fixed-scale native display alone uses the existing 1e-30 dB floor.

fixedGainResponseLevels.identityMetricUse: reported separately; RMS/peak are not included in ERB shape cosine

fullErbTimeCosine.dominanceDefinition: fraction of all within/between value pairs where within is greater; ties count one half

integratedErbProfileCosine.dominanceDefinition: fraction of all within/between value pairs where within is greater; ties count one half

lateTailErbProfileCosine.dominanceDefinition: fraction of all within/between value pairs where within is greater; ties count one half

descriptiveNearestNeighbor.method: nearest of the other 35 by full unit-sum ERB-time cosine; ties ordered by response id

limits: This is a descriptive comparison within a selected frozen 12-Plate set; nearest-neighbor counts are not classification performance or generalization.
The comparison tests measured auditory-band structure, not human identification, audibility, preference or production sonic quality.
Same-position between-Plate contacts share a path-position label, not identical spatial coordinates or modal projection.
ERB-binned STFT reorganizes fixed-gain STFT power; it is not a gammatone filterbank or cochleogram.
